title.target: gē lǐ yě yǒu tā de wèizhì

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào xī jiē shí , dìyījiàn shì shì xiǎng zhǎo diǎn dōngxī bān .
pairs.english: When Tavi reached West Steps, his first thought was to find something to carry.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到西阶时，第一件事是想找点东西搬。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn mǐlā zhàn zài ǎiqiáng shàng guà zhǐdài , biàn guòqù fú tīzǐ .
pairs.english: Seeing Mira standing on a low wall hanging paper ribbons, he went to steady the ladder.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见米拉站在矮墙上挂纸带，便过去扶梯子。

pairs.target: mǐlā dītóu kàn tā , shuō jiǎoxià shì shítou , méiyǒu tīzǐ .
pairs.english: Mira looked down and said she was standing on stone: there was no ladder.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉低头看他，说脚下是石头，没有梯子。

pairs.target: sū yǐ zài pángbiān xiào , jiào tā wǎng hòutuì , kànkàn liǎngtóu shìbushì yíyàng gāo .
pairs.english: Suyi laughed beside them and told him to step back and see whether the two ends were level.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡在旁边笑，叫他往后退，看看两头是不是一样高。

pairs.target: tā tuì le sānbù , shuō yòubiān dī , tāmen biàn bǎ zuǒbiān yě fàng dī yìdiǎn , miǎnde zhēzhù guòlùrén de liǎn .
pairs.english: He took three steps back and said the right was lower, so they lowered the left too, to avoid blocking passersby's faces.
pairs.hanzi: 他退了三步，说右边低，她们便把左边也放低一点，免得遮住过路人的脸。

pairs.target: yuē hǎo de héchàng jiù zài zhèkuài shíjiē jiān de píngdì .
pairs.english: The planned singing would take place on this landing among the stone steps.
pairs.hanzi: 约好的合唱就在这块石阶间的平地。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn shì tōng xuégōng de lù , xiàmiàn liǎngpái zhùhù cháo zhèlǐ kāichuāng .
pairs.english: Above lay the road to the academy; below, two rows of homes opened their windows toward it.
pairs.hanzi: 上面是通学宫的路，下面两排住户朝这里开窗。

pairs.target: mài dòu tāng de rén bǎ dànzi tíng zài guǎijiǎo , guōgài xiānqǐ láishí , rèqì bǎ chuíxiàlái de zhǐdài nòngshī le yìjiǎo .
pairs.english: The bean-soup seller set his carrying pole at the corner. When he lifted the pot lid, steam dampened a corner of a hanging paper ribbon.
pairs.hanzi: 卖豆汤的人把担子停在拐角，锅盖掀起来时，热气把垂下来的纸带弄湿了一角。

pairs.target: tā dāying liú dào chàng wán , què bù dāying xuéshēng shēzhàng .
pairs.english: He agreed to stay until the singing ended, but would not let students buy on credit.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应留到唱完，却不答应学生赊账。

pairs.target: zhè sāntiān lǐ , éwài liànxí zhī duō kāi le yìhuí .
pairs.english: Over the three days, only one extra practice session had been held.
pairs.hanzi: 这三天里，额外练习只多开了一回。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī néng lái de nàge qīngzǎo , tǎ wéi àn yuē qù jiào dé mǎ ,
pairs.english: On the early morning when Instructor Vey was available, Tavi went to wake Dema as promised.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师能来的那个清早，塔维按约去叫德玛，

pairs.target: tā kāimén shí tóufa cháo yìbiān qiào , shǒulǐ què yǐjīng niē zhe jìlùzhǐ .
pairs.english: She opened the door with her hair sticking sideways, but the record sheet already in her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她开门时头发朝一边翘，手里却已经捏着记录纸。

pairs.target: dìèrtiān lǎoshī lìng yǒu ānpái , méi zài kāi wū .
pairs.english: The next day the instructor had other commitments and the room did not open early again.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天老师另有安排，没再开屋。

pairs.target: shào lǐ réng xián búgòu , yě méiyǒu shuí shuō tā duō liàn yícì jiù gāi zhīzú .
pairs.english: Shaoli still felt it was not enough, and nobody told him one extra session should satisfy him.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里仍嫌不够，也没有谁说他多练一次就该知足。

pairs.target: cǐkè tā yě zài xī jiē , zuòzài zuì wàibiān , xī shàng tānzhe běnzi .
pairs.english: Now he too was at West Steps, seated at the outer edge with a book spread on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 此刻他也在西阶，坐在最外边，膝上摊着本子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cóng tā miànqián jīngguò , tā táitóu diǎn le yíxià , jiēzhe yòng shǒu dǎngzhù fēng chuīdòng de shūyè .
pairs.english: As Tavi passed, he looked up and nodded, then held down the windblown pages.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从他面前经过，他抬头点了一下，接着用手挡住风吹动的书页。

pairs.target: liǎng rén méi tí qiānmíng zhǐ , tǎ wéi yě méiyǒu yīncǐ juéde shénme dōu guòqù le .
pairs.english: Neither mentioned the petition, and Tavi did not take that to mean everything had passed.
pairs.hanzi: 两人没提签名纸，塔维也没有因此觉得什么都过去了。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng wūyánxià chūlái , lǐngkǒu kòu cuò le yìkē , bào zhe yíluò gē běn , zuǐlǐ hái zài qīngqīng hēng .
pairs.english: Iven came out from under the eaves with his collar wrongly buttoned, hugging a stack of songbooks and humming softly.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文从屋檐下出来，领口扣错了一颗，抱着一摞歌本，嘴里还在轻轻哼。

pairs.target: tā jiàn tǎ wéi shēnshǒu , jiù bǎ zuì shàngmiàn de yìběn dìgěi tā . " gěi shuí sòng ? " " gěi nǐ . "
pairs.english: Seeing Tavi reach out, he handed him the top book. “Who should I take it to?” “You.”
pairs.hanzi:
他见塔维伸手，就把最上面的一本递给他。
“给谁送？”
“给你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi fānkāi , tóu yíyè búshì zì , shì sìdào zhǐlù shìde cūxiàn , xiàmiàn cái xiě zhe jǐjù duǎn cí .
pairs.english: Tavi opened it. The first page began with four thick lines like directions, with a few short lyrics below.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维翻开，头一页不是字，是四道指路似的粗线，下面才写着几句短词。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ méi pái guò . yīwén shuō hòumiàn nàduàn dàjiā dōu huì gēn , tīng liǎngbiàn yě néng chàng ,
pairs.english: He said he had not rehearsed. Iven said everyone could join the later part after hearing it twice.
pairs.hanzi: 他说自己没排过。伊文说后面那段大家都会跟，听两遍也能唱，

pairs.target: chàng cuò le bié qiǎng zài biérén qiánmiàn jiù xíng .
pairs.english: If he sang the wrong words, he just shouldn't rush ahead of the others.
pairs.hanzi: 唱错了别抢在别人前面就行。

pairs.target: " wǒ lái tīng yě bùxíng ? " " xíng . zhǐshì bié yí dào zhèlǐ jiù tì wǒmen zhǎo huó gān . "
pairs.english: “Can't I just listen?” “You can. Just don't come here and immediately find work to do for us.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我来听也不行？”
“行。只是别一到这里就替我们找活干。”

pairs.target: yīwén shuō zhe bǎ lǐngkǒu chóngxīn kòuhǎo , jiào tā zhàn dào néng kànjiàn zìjǐ táishǒu de dìfāng .
pairs.english: As he spoke, Iven refastened his collar and told him to stand where he could see his raised hand.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说着把领口重新扣好，叫他站到能看见自己抬手的地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bào zhe gē běn wǎng rénqún biānshàng zǒu , fāxiàn dé mǎ yǐjīng lái le ,
pairs.english: Holding the songbook, Tavi walked to the crowd's edge and discovered Dema already there.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抱着歌本往人群边上走，发现德玛已经来了，

pairs.target: zhèng tóngyígè lǎofùrén zhēng yìzhī qǔzi jiūjìng gāi cóng nǎlǐ huànqì .
pairs.english: She was arguing with an old woman about exactly where to breathe in a tune.
pairs.hanzi: 正同一个老妇人争一支曲子究竟该从哪里换气。

pairs.target: lǎofùrén shuō zìjǐ niánqīng shí chàng shàngshān dōu bù chuǎn , dé mǎ shuō tā xiànzài yě méi shǎo chuǎn , liǎng rén yìqǐ xiào le .
pairs.english: The woman said she had sung all the way uphill without panting when young. Dema said she did plenty of panting now, and they laughed together.
pairs.hanzi: 老妇人说自己年轻时唱上山都不喘，德玛说她现在也没少喘，两人一起笑了。

pairs.target: kāitóu chàng dé yǒudiǎn sàn . wūyánxià de rén tīngdéjiàn bǐcǐ , zhàn dào píngdìshàng de jǐgè rén què màn le bànpāi .
pairs.english: The opening was a little ragged. Those beneath the eaves could hear one another, but a few on the landing fell half a beat behind.
pairs.hanzi: 开头唱得有点散。屋檐下的人听得见彼此，站到平地上的几个人却慢了半拍。

pairs.target: yīwén méiyǒu tíng , wǎnghòu tuìyíbù , bǎshǒu jǔ gāo , děng xià yíjù shí dàjiā cái hé dào yíchù .
pairs.english: Iven did not stop. He stepped back, raised his hand high, and they came together on the next phrase.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文没有停，往后退一步，把手举高，等下一句时大家才合到一处。

pairs.target: lóushàng yǒu gè háizi gēnzhe qiāo chuāngkuàng , bèi rén bàoxiàlái , shǒulǐ réng wò zhe yìbǎ mù sháo .
pairs.english: A child upstairs drummed along on the window frame, then was carried down still clutching a wooden spoon.
pairs.hanzi: 楼上有个孩子跟着敲窗框，被人抱下来，手里仍握着一把木勺。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhī zhāngzuǐ , méi chū duōshǎo shēng . mǐlā zhàn dào pángbiān , chàng dé hěn kěndìng , què cuò le yígè cí .
pairs.english: Tavi only moved his mouth, making little sound. Mira stood beside him and sang confidently, but got one word wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维只张嘴，没出多少声。米拉站到旁边，唱得很肯定，却错了一个词。

pairs.target: tā piāntóu kàn tā , tā miànbùgǎisè dì fānyè , xiǎoshēng shuō zhè shì tājiā de chàngfǎ .
pairs.english: He turned to look at her. Without changing expression, she turned the page and quietly said this was her family's version.
pairs.hanzi: 他偏头看她，她面不改色地翻页，小声说这是她家的唱法。

pairs.target: guò le yíhuìer , lún dào děng chuán lái .
pairs.english: After a while came Waiting for the Boat.
pairs.hanzi: 过了一会儿，轮到《等船来》。

pairs.target: lǐngchàng de rén wèn chuán hái méi lái , yào bǎ shénme liúzài ànshàng ,
pairs.english: The lead singer asked what to leave on shore while the boat had not yet come.
pairs.hanzi: 领唱的人问船还没来，要把什么留在岸上，

pairs.target: hòumiàn de rén jiē yíjiàn dōngxī , zài chàng chuán huílái shíhuì buhuì hái rènde .
pairs.english: The others answered with an object, then sang whether it would still be recognized when the boat returned.
pairs.hanzi: 后面的人接一件东西，再唱船回来时会不会还认得。

pairs.target: zhè búshì tǎ wéi tīng guò de quánbù chàngfǎ , huī ào nàbiān yǒurén ài chàng chéng qiànxià de jiǔqián , chàng dào zuìhòu , chuánzhǔ gàncuì bù huílái le .
pairs.english: This was not quite the version Tavi knew. In Ash Hollow, people liked to sing about unpaid drink debts; by the end, the boat owner simply never returned.
pairs.hanzi: 这不是塔维听过的全部唱法，灰坳那边有人爱唱成欠下的酒钱，唱到最后，船主干脆不回来了。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn qiánpái yígè lǎorén guǒrán jiē le jiǔqián , pángbiān rén xiào zhe tuī tā .
pairs.english: Sure enough, an old man in front answered “drink debts,” and his laughing neighbor nudged him.
pairs.hanzi: 他听见前排一个老人果然接了酒钱，旁边人笑着推他。

pairs.target: yīwén yě xiào , méi bǎ zhè yíjù jiūzhèng huí gē běn .
pairs.english: Iven laughed too and did not correct the line back to the songbook.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文也笑，没把这一句纠正回歌本。

pairs.target: jiēxiàqù yǒurén chàng jiù xié , yǒurén chàng yìlán méi màidiào de cōng , shēngyīn yì céngdié yìcéng , zuìhòu shuí yě tīngbùqīng shuí xiān shuō de .
pairs.english: Next came old shoes, then a basket of unsold scallions; voices overlapped until nobody could tell who spoke first.
pairs.hanzi: 接下去有人唱旧鞋，有人唱一篮没卖掉的葱，声音一层叠一层，最后谁也听不清谁先说的。

pairs.target: dé mǎ hūrán chàng le yíjù yàn jǐ nàbiān de cí .
pairs.english: Dema suddenly sang a line from Goose Ridge.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛忽然唱了一句雁脊那边的词。

pairs.target: tā bǎ chuán huànchéng xuě , àn huànchéng ménqián de shítou ,
pairs.english: She replaced the boat with snow and the shore with the stone outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 她把船换成雪，岸换成门前的石头，

pairs.target: shuō děng xuě kāi le , yào bǎ qùnián luòxià de jiǎoyìn zhǎo huílái .
pairs.english: When the snow thawed, she sang, they would find last year's footprints again.
pairs.hanzi: 说等雪开了，要把去年落下的脚印找回来。

pairs.target: wěiyīn bǐ zhèbiān cháng , hòumiàn jǐgè rén yǐjīng jí zhe jiē , jiéguǒ zhuàng zài yìqǐ .
pairs.english: Her final note lasted longer than the local version, and several eager voices came in too soon and collided.
pairs.hanzi: 尾音比这边长，后面几个人已经急着接，结果撞在一起。

pairs.target: yīwén táishǒu ràng tāmen děng , bǎ tā gāngcái nà yíjù mànmàn lǐng le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Iven raised his hand for them to wait, then slowly led them through her line again.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文抬手让他们等，把她刚才那一句慢慢领了一遍。

pairs.target: dìèrcì zhòngrén jiēshàng , dé mǎ què xiān xiào dé chàng bú xiàqù , lǎofùrén tì tā chēng wán le zuìhòu jǐgè zì .
pairs.english: The second time everyone joined, but Dema laughed too hard to go on; the old woman sustained the last few words for her.
pairs.hanzi: 第二次众人接上，德玛却先笑得唱不下去，老妇人替她撑完了最后几个字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngdào yú wān nà zhāng hái zài lùshang de xìn .
pairs.english: Tavi thought of the letter to Elmbay still on its journey.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想到榆湾那张还在路上的信。

pairs.target: tā bù zhīdào qiáo jiě zhèshí zǒu dào nǎlǐ , yě bù zhīdào huílái de huì shì yíjù jìde , háishì yìzhāng shuō zhǎo búdào de zhǐ .
pairs.english: He did not know where Sister Qiao had reached or whether what came back would be “I remember” or a page saying nothing could be found.
pairs.hanzi: 他不知道荞姐这时走到哪里，也不知道回来的会是一句记得，还是一张说找不到的纸。

pairs.target: pángbiān mǐlā de gēbo pèng le pèng tā , xià yíjù yǐjīng lái le .
pairs.english: Mira's arm nudged him; the next line had already come.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边米拉的胳膊碰了碰他，下一句已经来了。

pairs.target: tā dītóu zhǎocí , cuòguò le kāitóu , gāncuì gēnzhe chàng zuìhòu liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: He looked down for the words, missed the opening, and simply joined in for the final two.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头找词，错过了开头，干脆跟着唱最后两个字。

pairs.target: shēngyīn chūlái de bǐ tā xiǎng de dà .
pairs.english: His voice emerged louder than he expected.
pairs.hanzi: 声音出来得比他想的大。

pairs.target: mǐlā niǔtóu kàn tā , tā zhèhuí méi tíng , yě méi qù kàn shào lǐ huì buhuì tīngjiàn .
pairs.english: Mira turned toward him. This time he did not stop or look to see whether Shaoli could hear.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉扭头看他，他这回没停，也没去看邵里会不会听见。

pairs.target: yīwén zài rénqún qiánmiàn jǔ zhuóshǒu , zhǎngxīn bèi xiézhào de rì guāngzhào dé fāhóng .
pairs.english: Iven stood before the crowd with his hand raised, its palm glowing red in the slanting sunlight.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在人群前面举着手，掌心被斜照的日光照得发红。

pairs.target: chàng wán yǐhòu , mài tāng de rén yòng sháozǐ qiāo guō biān , shuō zàibùlái , dòuzǐ jiùyào péi tāmen děng chuán .
pairs.english: After the singing, the soup seller tapped his pot with the ladle, saying the beans would have to wait for the boat too if they didn't come now.
pairs.hanzi: 唱完以后，卖汤的人用勺子敲锅边，说再不来，豆子就要陪他们等船。

pairs.target: dàjiā jǐguòqù , mǐlā xiān hùzhù zhǐdài , sū yǐ máng zhe chāi xiàmiàn de shéng .
pairs.english: Everyone crowded over. Mira first protected the paper ribbons while Suyi hurried to untie the lower cord.
pairs.hanzi: 大家挤过去，米拉先护住纸带，苏苡忙着拆下面的绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ gē běn jiá jìn yīdài , xiǎng bāngmáng shí , yīwén jiàozhù tā ,
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the songbook into his pocket and was about to help when Iven called him back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把歌本夹进衣袋，想帮忙时，伊文叫住他，

pairs.target: shuō zìjǐ de sǎngzi yǐjīng xiàng shāzhǐ , néng bunéng péi tā qù mǎi wǎn tāng .
pairs.english: His throat felt like sandpaper, he said; would Tavi accompany him to buy soup?
pairs.hanzi: 说自己的嗓子已经像砂纸，能不能陪他去买碗汤。

pairs.target: tāmen duān zhe wǎn zuò dào xià yījí shíjiē . tǎ wéi wèn xiàcì hái chàng bu chàng ,
pairs.english: They sat one step lower with their bowls. Tavi asked whether they would sing again.
pairs.hanzi: 他们端着碗坐到下一级石阶。塔维问下次还唱不唱，

pairs.target: yīwén shuōchàng , suíhòu yòu kàn tā yìyǎn , wèn tā shì zhēn xiǎnglái , háishì xiān wèn le hǎo bǎ shíchén ràng chūqù .
pairs.english: Iven said yes, then looked at him and asked whether he really wanted to come, or was asking so he could give the time away first.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说唱，随后又看他一眼，问他是真想来，还是先问了好把时辰让出去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèi wèn dé xiào qǐlái , shuō zhèhuí xiān jì zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: The question made Tavi laugh. He said this time he would mark his own time first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维被问得笑起来，说这回先记自己的。

pairs.target: yīwén tāochū bǐ , zhǐ què dōu shōuzǒu le ,
pairs.english: Iven took out his pen, but the paper had all been packed away.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文掏出笔，纸却都收走了，

pairs.target: biàn zài gē běn zuìhòu yíyè xiě le shàngdài shāngliáng de rìzi , méiyǒu huà chéng yǐjīng dìng hǎo de quān .
pairs.english: He wrote a date still to be discussed on the songbook's last page without circling it as settled.
pairs.hanzi: 便在歌本最后一页写了尚待商量的日子，没有画成已经定好的圈。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù xuégōng de běi yì réng dǎng zhe bùlián .
pairs.english: In the distance, the academy's north wing was still screened by canvas.
pairs.hanzi: 远处学宫的北翼仍挡着布帘。

pairs.target: yǒurén cóng nàlǐ tái chū yìkǔn jiù mùbǎn , yán lìng yìtiáo lù xiàshān , lí dé tài yuǎn , kànbùchū shì shuí .
pairs.english: Someone carried a bundle of old boards out and down the mountain by another road, too far away to recognize.
pairs.hanzi: 有人从那里抬出一捆旧木板，沿另一条路下山，离得太远，看不出是谁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hē le yìkǒu tāng , bǎ wǎn wǎng xī shàng fàngwěn .
pairs.english: Tavi took a sip of soup and steadied his bowl on his knees.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维喝了一口汤，把碗往膝上放稳。

pairs.target: yīwén jiào tā fān huí gāngcái méi gēnshàng de nà yíyè , shuō chèn hái jìde diàozi , zài lái yícì .
pairs.english: Iven told him to turn back to the page he had missed and try again while they still remembered the tune.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文叫他翻回刚才没跟上的那一页，说趁还记得调子，再来一次。
